data.name: Pour Boy and the Nitro Necromancer
data.detailed_description:
Current Early Access scope:

Roughly 30 minutes of gameplay at this time (6/3/26). 
A compact, replayable first chapter playable from start to finish. Fight through the graveyard, complete NPC objectives, collect flies, unlock the boss, and defeat the Nitro Necromancer. More quests, enemies, secrets, puzzles, polish, and content are planned after launch. Replayable in an arcade sense: beat your high score. 

A hand-drawn coffee-horror platformer from a real Savannah coffee shop

Pour Boy and the Nitro Necromancer is a hand-drawn 2D action platformer set in the haunted coffee universe of Pour Boy Coffee.

Fight your way through a cursed graveyard, destroy coffee-born monsters, collect hidden flies, complete strange character quests, and earn the key to face the Nitro Necromancer.

But be careful.

The moon is getting closer.

If the timer runs out, the moon swallows you whole — and your run begins again from the start.

Fight monsters. Collect flies. Beat the moon.

Your goal is simple:

Destroy every Zombrew, Decaf Drone, and Bittergeist before the moon reaches the level.

If you clear the graveyard in time, the Grounds Keeper will reward you with a key to the boss.

Along the way, you’ll:

  • Fight hand-drawn coffee monsters

  • Collect hidden flies

  • Complete character quests

  • Find secrets

  • Explore a haunted graveyard

  • Survive the moon timer

  • Unlock the boss battle

  • Face the Nitro Necromancer

Death is not the end — unless the moon gets you

You have infinite lives, and your progress carries over between normal deaths.

Your health slowly regenerates, but two or three quick hits can still wipe you out. Play carefully, pick your moments, and don’t let the monsters overwhelm you.

If the moon swallows you, all progress is lost and the run begins again.

In the boss battle, there is no timer. Instead, your extra lives are based on how many flies you collected before entering the fight.

The more you explore, the better your chances.

Built by one coffee shop owner

This game was built and drawn by me, Keith — the same guy behind the Pour Boy coffee trailer, the Savannah coffee shop, and the Pour Boy graphic novel series.

There are years of character design, storybuilding, animation practice, coffee drinks, gothic horror influences, and weird little lore decisions behind this world.

Pour Boy and the Nitro Necromancer is the first playable step into that universe, with more quests, secrets, puzzles, polish, and strange coffee-horror madness planned after launch.

Thanks for giving it a shot.

And if you’re ever in Savannah, come get a shot of espresso from the cafe.

Early Access Note

This Early Access version is playable from start to finish.

You can complete the graveyard, fight enemies, collect flies, earn the key, face the boss, and beat the game. Future updates are planned to add more quests, zombies, secrets, puzzles, polish, and expanded content.

data.short_description: A hand-animated coffee horror platformer from the world of Pour Boy Coffee. Fight zombrews, collect flies, complete quests, find secrets, and survive the crashing moon to face the Nitro Cold Brew Necromancer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 / AMD Radeon R7 240 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard recommended. Gamepad supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / GT 1030 / AMD Radeon RX 550 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: I am troubleshooting controller support. Your feedback matters.
